_about: Agent-facing spec for the MINI class-project tunnel (1:43 car, Arduino Uno control, budget <= NT$5,000). Geometry is the 1:18 design (spec/geometry.json) scaled by 0.42, except: fan end (2x2 array of 120 mm 12 V fans, square diffuser exit), fixed V-saddles instead of rollers, 3 mm panels, and spacing rules scaled. Units mm unless the key says otherwise. 'tbd' = decide after measuring the purchased car or parts.

frame.origin: x=0 at the contraction exit plane; y=0 on the tunnel centreline; z=0 on the test-section floor inner surface
frame.duct_axis_note: all modules coaxial with the test section

honeycomb.make: drinking straws (6 mm) or 3D-printed hex tiles

conditioning.screen_material: polyester voile or stainless mesh, open area checked

contraction.profile: h(s) = hi - (hi - he) * (6 t^5 - 15 t^4 + 10 t^3), t = s / L, same law for width and height
contraction.wall_sheet: 0.5-1 mm PET or PC sheet over laser-cut or hand-cut plywood/MDF ribs
contraction.exit_step_rule: any residual step must be backward-facing (downstream wall recessed outward)

diffuser.make: four flat trapezoid panels (rectangle to square)

fan.model: 4 x Delta PFC1212DE (or equivalent 120x120x38 12 V 4-wire PWM high-static fan), 2x2 array
fan.curve_note: linear between published max flow and max static pressure; real curve to be checked

losses_K._note: referred to test-section q; diffuser, safety screen and exit follow AR = 2.72

car._note: planning values for a typical 1:43 hatchback; measure the purchased model in week 1

cradle.type: fixed V-saddle per wheel (3D-printed PETG or aluminium)
cradle.rule: saddle contact points below plate top; pitch set by saddle shims only

plenum.skirt: thin rubber (glove latex or balloon) between plenum floor and pedestal

pins.D9: fan PWM, Timer1 25 kHz, all 4 fan PWM wires
pins.D8: hatch interlock switch (input pull-up; open = fans off)
pins.A0: HX711 #3 DT (bell manometer, speed sensor A)
pins.A4: I2C SDA (backup BMP280 0x76 and 0x77, optional LCD1602 0x27)

speed_sensor._note: two home-made sensors on the same taps (tees): A is the main one, B is backup and cross-check; C only if both fail
speed_sensor.plumbing: high side (Pitot total, or settling ring) -> box air of A and canister B_hi; low side (Pitot static, or entrance ring) -> inside of the bell and canister B_lo

bell.material: 3D-printed PETG, straight cylinder (not a tapered cup), closed top with hook eye

snorkel.tube: 4 mm brass tube bent into a U, enters the bell from below the rim

A_bell_manometer.box: airtight food container >= 1.5 L; load cell on a rigid bracket glued to the box floor (not the lid); wires out through a hot-glued hole
A_bell_manometer.sign: lower pressure inside the bell -> bell pulled down -> load rises with q (hanger can be a thread)
A_bell_manometer.effective_area: calibrate; expect between inner and mean-wall area
A_bell_manometer.auto_zero: average 5 s with fans off before every run

B_barometer_pair.part: 2 x BMP280 module with on-board 3.3 V regulator and level shifting (5 V safe)
B_barometer_pair.mounting: each sealed in a 35 mm film canister or small airtight box with one tube barb; both taped together and wrapped in foam so they stay at the same temperature
B_barometer_pair.also_gives: absolute pressure and temperature for air density (replaces the optional BME280)
B_barometer_pair.auto_zero: average 5 s with fans off before every run; subtract the B_hi - B_lo offset

speed_sensor.C_last_resort: buy Honeywell ABP2MRRN001ND2A3XX (DigiKey Taiwan NT$755, +NT$600 shipping under NT$1,400; 3.3 V only, needs a level shifter) or use the water manometer + fan-speed table

calibration.reference: inclined water manometer, slope 1:10, 4 mm ID clear tube on a board >= 300 mm, coloured water
calibration.source: 60 mL syringe through a tee; points 0, 2, 5, 10, 15, 20 mm water vertical, up then down, 3 repeats

speed_sensor.fallback_rule: use A if it passes calibration and agrees with B in the tunnel; else B (5 m/s less accurate); else C

psu.option: old ATX PC power supply (12 V rail >= 20 A) or 12 V 25 A LED supply

electronics.estop: latching switch in the 12 V line to the fans (hardware, independent of the Uno)

items.item: 4 x 12038 PWM fan (Delta PFC1212DE or equivalent)
items.basis: US$16-24 each in 2026 listings (Newegg, eBay, Walmart); about NT$500-750

items.item: speed sensor A: 100 g load cell + HX711, airtight box, oil, fittings (bell printed at school)
speed sensor B: 2 x BMP280 5 V modules, 2 film canisters / small boxes
calibration: inclined manometer tube + board, 60 mL syringe, tees

items.basis: free if an old ATX PSU is available; open-frame 12 V 20 A ~US$17 wholesale, retail estimate NT$500-900

items.item: 100 g + 1 kg load cells, 2 x HX711
Pitot tube 4 mm, brass U-tube for the bell snorkel, silicone tubing, tees
3 mm clear PC panels (test section + plenum, about 3.7 cai)
items.basis: NT$60-75 per cai in Yahoo listings, plus cutting fee

items.item: plywood/MDF ribs, 0.5-1 mm PET sheet, diffuser panels
straws or printed honeycomb, voile screens
18 AWG wire, fuse holder, E-stop, connectors, screws, glue

budget_ntd.first_cut_if_over: skip speed sensor B (saves NT$120-300); then the cheapest fans and a free ATX PSU
